messages:
anya: Heads up — seeing a 2x p50 latency spike on llama3-13b-hosted since we rolled kernel-selector v2 this morning. Spike correlated with KV-cache evictions during chat traffic. Anyone else see this? :eyes:
kevin: Can you paste the perf sample and which variant (quant / fp16) this was hitting? Also which chat template length?
anya: Hitting quant 4-bit pool; typical chat templates (system + 2 turns). Quick perf dump: https://internal.perf/trace/20617 — flamegraph shows long stall on 'kv_repack' and lots of `evict_kv` events. Snippet: ```
# perf counters
selected_kernel: matmul_v1 (fallback)
head_dim_runtime: 64
hidden_size: 5120
kv_evictions/sec: 0.18
avg_latency_ms: 312 -> 650
```
rob: That head_dim_runtime=64 is suspicious — model expected head_dim 128 (5120/40). Looks like quant path chose a narrow-head kernel slowpath. We've seen a "hidden-stride" mismatch before where the quant packing picks a 64-favoring kernel and ends up doing inefficient packing.
kevin: I repro locally with the same quant artifact. Kernel selector log shows rule evaluation: ```
if head_dim <= 64 -> use matmul_small
elif head_dim == 128 and seq_len < 64 -> use matmul_opt
else -> matmul_v1
```
But our runtime was reporting head_dim 64 because an earlier transform changed transpose ordering for SiLU fused layers.
sylvia: FYI we flipped the default fused-norm to RMSNorm+SiLU microkernel in model-adapter v1.2 last week. That can change the intermediate layout (NCHW-ish -> NHWC-ish) which confuses a selector predicate that assumes pre-fusion layout. Also rope_theta default was bumped (smaller theta scaling) for Llama3 in the catalog which interacts with KV layout heuristics.
rob: So two interacting causes: selector rule brittle to layout changes + rope_theta shift changing kernel perf surface. Short term: add a hard rule to prefer kv-friendly kernel when hidden_size % 128 == 0 and model_type in [llama2,llama3]. Also avoid selecting `matmul_small` for quant paths if num_heads*head_dim == hidden_size.
anya: For mitigation I rolled back kernel-selector v2 on the canary pool at 2061704200 and latency returned to baseline within 2 minutes. deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed for pool `canary-llama3-13b` at 2026-03-18T14:30:05Z. :white_check_mark: 
kevin: We should add a unit test in selector that validates kernel choice across layout permutations (pre/post-fusion) + rope_theta variants. Proposed reproduction command: ```
# reproduce load
ab -n 200 -c 8 -p chat_payload.json http://localhost:8080/v1/generate?model=llama3-13b&quant=4
# with model override
X-Model-Override: {"rope_theta":0.95,"fused_norm":"rms_silu"}
```
sylvia: Agreed. Also plan change: batcher heuristics — reduce `max_batch_ms` from 20->8 for chat-template routes where seq distribution > 64 to reduce KV merge churn and prevent large in-flight prefix batching that forces eviction. Add a selector fallback: if `kv_evictions/sec` > 0.05 during rollout, force `kv_friendly_kernel=true` on that node.
rob: I'll open a small PR to (1) tighten selector rules, (2) add layout permutation tests, (3) adjust batcher default for chat routes. 
anya: One more ask: add alerting rule on `kv_eviction_rate` and `p50_latency` delta for rollout windows. If kv_eviction_rate > 0.02 and p50 > baseline * 1.25 -> page oncall.
sylvia: +1 on alerting. I'll draft the alert + the selector unit tests.
rob: 👍 will open PR and assign reviewers (kevin, sylvia).
